footer.system: TB-CDSS | Tuberculosis Clinical Decision Support System
sidebar.note_text: Supporting safer and faster preliminary TB screening.
home.title: Tuberculosis Screening and Risk Assessment System
home.description: A professional web-based decision support system for preliminary TB screening, risk classification, laboratory test recommendation, and multilingual access.
home.card1_text: Supports early identification of suspected tuberculosis cases.
home.card2_text: Provides risk levels, recommendations, and laboratory test guidance.
home.card3_text: Supports English, Yoruba, Hausa, and Igbo for wider accessibility.
screen.title: Tuberculosis Patient Screening Form
screen.description: Enter patient information and symptom details to assess risk level, generate recommendations, and suggest appropriate laboratory tests.
screen.form.title: Patient Screening Assessment
screen.form.text: Complete the form below to assess preliminary TB risk and generate clinical recommendations.
screen.patient_text: Basic demographic information for the patient.
screen.symptom_text: Select the response that best matches patient symptoms.
screen.q2: Have you been coughing for more than 2 weeks?
screen.q4: Have you experienced unexplained weight loss?
dashboard.title: Healthcare Worker Overview
dashboard.text: Monitor screening records, risk distribution, and patient assessment outcomes.
dashboard.empty_records: No patient screening records have been submitted.
result.title: Patient TB Risk Assessment
result.text: This result is for preliminary clinical screening support only and does not replace professional medical diagnosis.
result.next.text: Follow the recommendation above and consult a qualified healthcare professional where necessary.
recommendation.low: Maintain good health practices and monitor symptoms.
recommendation.moderate: Visit a healthcare facility for sputum smear microscopy.
recommendation.high: Urgent evaluation required. Perform GeneXpert test and chest X-ray.
recommendation.emergency: Emergency referral required immediately for GeneXpert test, chest X-ray, and culture/drug susceptibility testing.
test.low: No immediate lab test recommended. Monitor symptoms and return if symptoms persist.
test.high: Recommended tests: GeneXpert (NAAT) and Chest X-ray.
test.emergency: Recommended urgent tests: GeneXpert (NAAT), Chest X-ray, and TB culture/drug susceptibility testing.
login.title: Healthcare Worker Login
login.text: Sign in with your assigned credentials to access patient records, dashboard analytics, screening history, and clinical report tools.
login.form_text: Only authorized healthcare personnel can access this system.
login.notice_text: Contact the system administrator if you do not have login credentials.
